name: Wildbend River
summary: Near the Grove of the Ancients, Wildbend River carries demonic poison toward the sea. Its waters cross southern Darkshore from the corrupted heights of Felwood and threaten the wilderness.

sections.title: A Toxic Mountain Stream
sections.body: Wildbend River carries corruption through southern Darkshore. It runs west past the Grove of the Ancients and empties into the sea. The stream begins as Felwood's Bloodvenom River, then tumbles through rocky ridges with foul runoff. Night elves watch its banks for twisted wildlife and spreading demonic blight.

faq.q: Why is the Wildbend River corrupted?
faq.answer: Wildbend River begins high in Felwood's mountains, where it is called the Bloodvenom River. Demonic magic saturated Felwood during the Third War, and foul runoff spills down the cliffs into Darkshore.
Wildbend River descends from the eastern ridges between Felwood and Darkshore. It winds through southern Darkshore near the Grove of the Ancients, then empties into the Veiled Sea.

faq.q: Does the river affect the Grove of the Ancients?
faq.answer: Wildbend River passes close to the Grove of the Ancients and threatens the ancient protectors rooted there. Night elves work tirelessly to contain the blight and keep poisoned water from rotting the sacred groves.

angles.text: As a night elf warden, you often watch the riverbanks as polluted water from Felwood threatens Darkshore's ancient roots.
As a druid, you study the ecological aftermath of the Third War and watch how deeply Felwood's corruption reaches plants and animals downstream.
